text: You read "range resolving upward with mp 96.0 and day_vol 1.85." The field says it has not resolved: structure_shift RANGE, no pivot cleared, and you yourself place it "at the top edge, not the test." Worse for me, its staples peers KDP and WMT broke out while CHD did not. A stock failing to make new highs with its group is grounds to revise without waiting for a reason (C14). Momentum inside the range is not a new high (C5). What clears it: a BULLISH_BOS that joins KDP and WMT. Then I support it as the third staples confirmation.
